title: Knowledge Of The Future
paragraphs: “Huh? Huh?”
Itsuki looked at the bowing queen with a surprised expression. On the other hand, Ren folded his arms and took a stance of observing the situation, as if trying to hide his own surprise.
“I apologize for summoning the Four Holy Heroes without permission and causing you trouble.”
“W-What do you mean? The king was at the castle, introduced himself as if it was natural, and asked us to save this world.”
“Despite that, the real ruler of this country is the queen? What’s going on?”
Everyone was being careful with their words here, knowing that speaking carelessly would make it difficult to gain trust. Therefore, we must proceed with extreme caution in explaining.

“Our country is a matriarchy, and Aultcray serves as a regent while I’m away on diplomatic missions. Normally, capable subordinates would maintain the country, but… I recently received word that they perished in the waves a few days ago.”
“Diplomatic missions?”
“Itsuki, Japan has something similar, right? When the Prime Minister goes abroad for a conference. It’s like that.”
“I see. So, during that time, someone was acting as a substitute and pretending to be the king?”
The queen nodded in response to Itsuki’s question. Oh, this is progressing more smoothly than if I had explained it. I feel a little frustrated, but I’ll leave it to the queen.
“I’m still half-convinced about whose story to believe. But what brings the queen here?”

“I was originally in a distant land attending a conference about the waves and witnessing the summoning of the heroes, but thanks to the power of teleportation from Kitamura-sama, the Spear Hero, I was able to return to Melromarc and was asked to witness the course of events.”
“Hmm… It’s true that Motoyasu used a teleportation skill to take me to the castle town. That makes sense.”
“I understand that this person is the queen. Whether that’s true or not, I’ll reserve judgment. So, my next question is: Why does Motoyasu-san know what’s going to happen?”
“I’ve also been wondering about that. I’ve heard that Kitamura-sama is very strong because he came from another world, but is there another reason?”
Ren, Itsuki, and the queen all stared at me intently. Last time, I stumbled a bit with my explanation, but this time I’ve memorized my lines under the supervision of Ren and Itsuki.
“You may not believe it, but I came from the future of this world. That’s how I know what’s going to happen.”
Upon hearing that, Ren once again fell deep into thought, while Itsuki tilted his head slightly. Same reaction as before. The queen was also pondering, just like Ren.
“Of course, before being summoned from the future, I was originally summoned from Japan of another world.”
“It’s hard to believe, but…”
Ren had mentioned that I didn’t need to change this part. If I remember correctly, Itsuki said this was what convinced him last time.
“If you don’t believe me, I can tell you about the knowledge I have of the future. For example, Itsuki’s world has supernatural abilities, does it not?”
“That’s such a given that it’s not even worth mentioning…”
“Huh!?”
Ren’s face was filled with astonishment. This was also the part that convinced him last time.
“Itsuki, I need confirmation. Is this talk of supernatural abilities true?”
“Y-Yes…”
“Did you tell anyone about that since coming to this world?”
“No, I haven’t. I mean, it’s such a basic thing that I didn’t think to mention it.”
“That reaction… Don’t tell me, Ren-san, in your world, there’s no such thing as supernatural abilities?”
“Yeah, they don’t exist. Even if they did, it would only be in works of fiction.”
“I-I see…”
“Well, if you count things like perfect pitch as supernatural abilities, then maybe, but that’s different, isn’t it?”
“Yes, supernatural abilities are mostly innate, so acquired traits like perfect pitch are different.”
Should I add something here? Sharing the knowledge I have might increase my credibility.
“By the way, Itsuki is incredibly talented at playing musical instruments. That’s pure talent, unrelated to abilities.”
“Is that so?”
“In the previous loop, Father and Ren praised him to no end.”
“I’m not aware of it myself… Besides, in a world with supernatural abilities, that kind of skill isn’t particularly valued.”
That attitude again. It’s a rather annoying demeanor. I can understand why Ren is slightly irritated.

“Itsuki, what Motoyasu is saying is probably true. There are no supernatural abilities in the Japan I came from. And only Itsuki should know that fact. If Itsuki and Motoyasu come from the same world, then Itsuki’s reaction is appropriate, and there should be no doubt.”
“That’s true…”

“Moreover, Motoyasu possesses portal skills and magic. If he truly came from the future, it’s not strange for him to have those abilities. And Motoyasu knew where I and Itsuki were. It’s a wild story, but the details align. And… about that woman.”
“I am deeply sorry for what my daughter has done…”
The queen apologized. It seems she believed us. Even in the previous analysis, it was said that she would believe us if we told her right after teleporting.
“I can tell you more. Can you still not believe it?”
“Then, Naofumi-san’s companion… the princess, wasn’t it? Why did she do such a thing?”
“That girl is a deviant who enjoys watching people suffer. Asking for a reason is pointless. She causes trouble as easily as breathing.”
The queen spoke decisively. Ren and Itsuki were left speechless. The queen is kind of interfering with my explanation.
“For now, it’s fine to think of that princess as a pawn. There’s still a mastermind pulling the strings behind the scenes.”
I interrupted the queen’s conclusion once.

“Their goal is to sow discord among the heroes. This country considers the Shield Hero to be a religious enemy nation… That’s why they framed fa—Naofumi as a criminal, with the ultimate goal of having us take him down.”
“An enemy, religiously!? So they want us to kill Naofumi-san?”

“I see. So, they’re trying to fulfill their desires by making us… or rather, the Sword, Spear, and Bow Heroes, who are considered religious gods in this country, kill Naofumi, who is seen as a demon.”
“If you think I’m lying, look at the church symbol visible from the square. You’ll see that it only depicts the sword, spear, and bow.”
In a way, they’re practically flaunting the evidence. Ren and Itsuki should have noticed it at least once today.

“Indeed, our country’s national religion is the Three Hero Church, a faith that worships the heroes present here. In that sense, it is hostile to Siltvelt, which venerates the Shield Hero. However… it was supposed to be a more peaceful religion…”
“Can you still believe that after what just happened?”

The queen’s attitude seemed hesitant, as if she were still half in doubt. Ah, since they’re operating in the shadows, they haven’t revealed their true colors yet. But the queen nodded several times as if trying to convince herself.
“Certainly, it’s not impossible that there’s a more extreme faction. If they’re replacing the equipment needed for the summoning of the Four Holy Heroes… there’s no defending that.”
“They’re also hiding weapons said to be copies of the heroes’ weapons.”
It’s the weapon the pope will definitely bring out. From where I stand now, it’s just a weak imitation, but it’s still a dangerous tool.

“I don’t know where they’ve hidden them, but if you investigate, you’ll find an unbelievable amount of dirt. Moreover, they demote, imprison, or confine nobles who try to build friendships with demi-humans.”
Éclair is a prime example. Father and the others asked me to help her.
“…Understood. We will investigate once things are settled.”
“An alternate world, heroes, conspiracy, and now future travelers… Things are getting complicated.”
Ren quietly nodded as if confirming his understanding.
“Even if it’s hard to believe, if the true ruler, the queen, has confirmed it, shouldn’t this be resolved quickly?”
“That’s true. We might not have any role in this.”
“They want us to kill Naofumi-san… It’s starting to feel like one of those novels I’ve read online.”
They mentioned that before. But it seems the outcome will be a bit different this time, which is a shame.
“Novel? What’s that?”
“There’s a story where someone gets summoned to another world but is abandoned by the country and summoners because they’re dissatisfied, and they rise up on their own.”
“Hmm…”
“It’s a scenario you’d expect to see in a game’s storyline.”
“Now that you mention it, I heard from an acquaintance during a beta test about a game with a similar story.”
“I’ve said this before. This isn’t a game or anything like that.”
“Naofumi-san is on the brink of facing something like that. By the way, in the future we don’t know the truth about, what do we do after this?”
“Are you asking about last time? Or the first time?”
From this point onward, I need to be extra cautious around Ren and Itsuki.
“Last time… You mean because of the loop?”
“That’s right.”
“So, you’re saying we’ve had this same conversation before?”
Ren and Itsuki sought confirmation from me.
“Well then… I’ll explain it step by step, starting from the first world.”
“Alright, I’ll tell you. In the first world… when I knew nothing, that woman… No, I’ll call her crimson swine because of her hair color. She deceived me and made fa—Naofumi out to be a rapist.”
“Indeed, if someone puts on a fake act and cries, it’s natural to look down on Naofumi.”
“Rape… Come to think of it, the woman who became my companion tried to seduce me blatantly. I was a little carried away. But calling her a pig…”
Itsuki glanced at the queen. Hmm, come to think of it, the queen is the mother of that crimson swine.
Perhaps I should have chosen my words more carefully?
“Motoyasu, calling her a pig when her mother is right here is a bit much.”
“No, you may call her a pig. That foolish daughter deserves nothing less.”
The queen’s killing intent began to spread as a chilling aura.
Oh! The queen has given her approval! It seems that skipping over the explanation of why I call him Father was unnecessary.
“We each go on adventures and level up while solving the country’s requests. But Naofumi receives no such support.”
“…That’s true.”
“Well, even if it was a false accusation, he’s still labeled as a rapist.”
“They summoned us without consent and then treated him so unfairly.”
“It’s unforgivable.”

I want to explain about the Filolials, but I was warned that it would be unnecessary here. So, I simplified it to something that would still convince Ren and Itsuki. In the previous loops, I was corrected about this several times, so I can explain it smoothly now.
“First, because we did whatever we pleased all over the place, the ecosystem of monsters in the country changed, causing problems.”
“Don’t they respawn?”
“Monsters are living beings too. If you kill them, their numbers go down.”
“…Y-Yeah, that’s true. And then?”

“Also, because we left guild jobs half-done, it caused even more disasters. In my case, I relied on game knowledge and unsealed a plant that was supposed to be sealed, saving a village suffering from famine. But that plant went out of control and became a catastrophe. Of course, Ren and Itsuki made similar mistakes.”
“Hmm… I don’t know the specifics, but I can see how that could happen.”
“Me too… So acting based on game knowledge leads to failure.”
“It’s a hard story to believe. But… it’s worth considering.”
“Eventually, because of our selfish actions, the Three Hero Church came to despise us, while at the same time, Naofumi and his companions cleaned up our messes and earned the people’s trust.”
“There’s a big difference between us, who acted selfishly, and Naofumi, who struggled from the bottom after being falsely accused.”
“That’s a future where we’re treated as villains… A grim prospect.”
The first world was filled with nothing but failures. It’s thanks to Father’s efforts that I am where I am now. Ah, Filo-tan…
After that, I explained how it all ended in tragedy due to the Three Hero Church’s conspiracy.
“Don’t you think that’s a terrible role to play?”
“Yeah.”
“Honestly, I’d like to escape from this country as soon as possible.”
“…I apologize. If possible, I would recommend moving to another country.”
“Ah… I see.”
Itsuki lowered his head apologetically, as if he had forgotten that the queen was here.
“So, Motoyasu, what about the last time?”
“Last time, I gave the same explanation, but the queen wasn’t here, and I didn’t know where she was.”
“Haa…”
“I see. Having the queen here is very reassuring, isn’t it?”
That’s right. Seeing is believing. With the queen witnessing it herself, they can’t make any excuses.
“So? Motoyasu, why did you come from the future? If you’re looping, there must be some conditions, right?”

“That’s correct. I have multiple defeat conditions, but one of them is that if Ren, Itsuki, or Naofumi dies, I get sent back to the day I was summoned. There was even a time when Itsuki was killed by one of his own companions.”
“Me? Killed by my companions!?”
It’s always one surprise after another.
Come to think of it, do I need to explain the conditions of the previous loop? It doesn’t seem necessary. My goal is to meet Filo-tan, after all.
“By those companions?”
“I don’t know Itsuki’s companions very well, but the man in armor who was Ren’s companion joined Itsuki’s party and eventually raised his hand against him.”
“I see…”
“Is that really true? Honestly, I can’t fully believe it… No, I suppose it’s more like I don’t want to believe that kind of future.”
This is another piece of undeniable evidence.
“If Itsuki believes me, tomorrow, the king will announce that the crimson swine falsely accused Naofumi of a crime and will try to have us killed. There was quite a commotion about that last time.”
“W-What did you say!?”
“It’s worth testing… But if the queen is here, that scenario might not happen.”
When Ren said that, the queen closed her fan and spoke.

“No, let’s proceed in that direction. I want to catch my husband, Altcray, red-handed. If that situation unfolds, I will intervene on the spot. I have more authority than him, so I should be able to restrain him.”
“If that doesn’t work, I’ll just take him down myself.”
“…Understood.”
“Is something like that really going to happen?”
“We can test it. If it happens, then Motoyasu’s story is real.”
After Ren spoke, Itsuki was silent for a moment, then nodded. It will definitely happen.
“…It can’t be helped.”
“Then how about we go hear the evidence that this chainmail was stolen? In the future, the evidence gets tampered with, but for now, we should be fine.”
“Yes, I’d definitely like to have that evidence. I’d like to hear it.”
The queen asked for confirmation with a somewhat suggestive tone.
“Somehow, I’m starting to feel like this is a performance the country is putting on to convince us to believe Motoyasu… I can’t say that’s completely impossible.”
“I get how you feel, but that’s a bit far-fetched. Do you know how much effort it would take to summon us from another world just to stage something like that?”
“That’s true… Even the queen’s credibility is questionable at this point.”
Are they starting to doubt things now that we’ve laid out so many facts? Well, that’s fine for now. For the time being, let’s steer Ren and Itsuki’s thoughts in another direction.
“Last time, as a reward for verifying the evidence here, Ren and Itsuki obtained weapons made of meteorite iron. You’ll get excellent skills from the Meteor Series.”
“What!?”
“Ah… Testing that might not be a bad idea.”
As expected, Ren and Itsuki are still as easy to sway as ever.
